The total amount of memory to allocate to messages before
offlining clients.
Default: 10% of total host memory or 10% of the amount of
host memory AMPS is allowed to consume (as reported by
ulimit -m ), whichever is lowest.

The total amount of disk space to allocate to messages
before disconnecting clients.
Default: 1GB or the amount specified in the
MessageMemoryLimit, whichever is highest.

The path to use to write offline files.
Default: /var/tmp
